product.title: Red and Blue Light Therapy Cap for Hair Growth
product.description_html:
Welcome thicker, healthier-looking hair with this Red and Blue Light Therapy Cap. Red light reaches deep into your scalp to support hair follicles, while blue light keeps the surface fresh and balanced. Together, these two wavelengths work in harmony to nourish thinning areas and promote a healthier environment for hair to thrive. This portable, hands-free cap slips comfortably into your routine with no fuss or mess. Set it for 10 to 20 minutes and get on with your day. Pair it with a consistent schedule, and you may notice a fuller, more vibrant appearance over time. Add it to your wellness routine and see what red and blue light can do.

Product information:
Color: Black
Dimensions: 24.5 × 21.5 × 6.2 cm
Specification: 70 beads
Function: Hair thickening


Packing list:
Hair cap *1 + USB *1+Color box *1
